items.title: Eli Lilly is trouncing Nvidia — and the weight-loss drug trade is beating AI again
items.summary: Since its Oct. 6 record, Nvidia has shed more than $1.7 trillion in market value. Eli Lilly has added more than $250 billion over the same stretch, a gain topped only by Apple among the market's biggest stocks.

items.title: Trump Says Jensen Huang Did Not Put National Security at Risk
items.summary: President Donald Trump says former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang did not put the US national security at risk and he says letting Huang run the chipmaker again isn't a bad idea. He speaks to reporters at the White House. Trump also says we don't know if Alice Huang is a Chinese spy, she is one of the women Jensen Huang had an affair with.

items.title: Apple (AAPL) Picks Core Foldable Glass Supplier For iPhone Duo
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) has selected Biel Crystal as a core supplier of ultra thin flexible glass for its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo. The Biel Crystal agreement covers ultra thin glass tailored for the iPhone Duo form factor, supporting Apple's planned foldable design. Supply chain sources describe Biel Crystal's UTG as a key material input that could influence durability and user experience for the iPhone Duo.
